thread:
rachel: Heads up, espresso machine leaked a tiny puddle under the drip tray when I used it at 11:40. I wiped most but left a paper towel. Please avoid the south counter for a bit.

tom: thanks rachel. is it sticky? can someone empty drip tray after next use?

priya: i can empty it after lunch. where's the drip tray tool? or just pull and pour in sink?

leo: pull, tilt, pour gently. there's a short note taped to the machine with a pic. also left a pack of choc-chip cookies on the island (gift from a client).

rachel: cookies labeled "share!" but please take only one or two so late folks get some.

tom: poll: weekly coffee duty rota? react :+1: yes, :-1: no. keeps machine in shape.

priya: :+1: I'll volunteer for Wednesdays once a month.

leo: :-1: I prefer ad hoc but happy to help when asked.

kitchen-bot: Kitchen Ops reminder: after using the espresso machine please 1) empty drip tray into sink 2) wipe the counter 3) if you spill, write a quick note and leave rag to dry. Label any personal fridge items as "Name / Date / Keep?". Unlabeled perishables older than 96 hours will be cleared on Fridays.

rachel: added oat creamer to the fridge (labeled). if someone wants almond instead next time, thumbs up.

priya: :+1: almond please.

tom: also FYI the cookie box had a tiny note: "gluten-free in the red bag". top shelf.

leo: cool. I'll take care of the drip tray after 2pm. thanks for the cookies rachel :)
